instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Return-to-service discussion: The goal is to control when repaired equipment can be used again. A Safety Verifier must clear equipment when the fault is safety-related before return to service. For a fault that is not safety-related, the Maintenance Planner may return the equipment to service once the repair is complete. The team has not defined how to decide whether a fault is safety-related.

output.summary: The project controls return-to-service decisions for repaired equipment. Safety-related faults require Safety Verifier clearance before equipment returns to service, while the Maintenance Planner may return non-safety-related equipment after repair completion. The method for determining whether a fault is safety-related remains undefined.
output.primary_goal: Control when repaired equipment can return to service.
key_capabilities: Require Safety Verifier clearance for safety-related faults before return to service.
Allow the Maintenance Planner to return non-safety-related equipment to service after repair completion.
unresolved_points: The rule for deciding whether a fault is safety-related is not defined.

instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for FaultFern Service Hold: The objective is to track equipment faults, repairs, safety clearance, and return-to-service decisions. Equipment Operators report abnormal behavior and mark affected equipment unavailable. Maintenance Planners set fault priority, assign repair work to Maintenance Technicians, and return non-safety-related equipment after repair completion. Maintenance Technicians record diagnoses and work performed and mark repairs complete. Safety Verifiers clear safety-related equipment before return to service. Purchasing spare parts is outside this project. The priority choices and the rule for identifying safety-related faults are still missing.

output.business_objective: Track equipment faults, repairs, safety clearance, and return-to-service decisions.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: FaultFern Service Hold briefing: The project is intended to track equipment faults, repair activity, safety clearance, and decisions to return equipment to service. Equipment Operators report abnormal behavior and make the equipment unavailable. Maintenance Technicians document the diagnosis and work performed and then mark the repair complete. Safety Verifiers clear safety-related equipment before return to service, while Maintenance Planners may return non-safety-related equipment after the repair is complete. The safety-related classification rule is not yet defined.

output.summary: FaultFern Service Hold tracks equipment faults, repair activity, safety clearance, and return-to-service decisions. Equipment Operators report abnormal behavior and make affected equipment unavailable, while Maintenance Technicians document diagnoses and work performed and mark repairs complete. Safety Verifiers clear safety-related equipment, and Maintenance Planners may return non-safety-related equipment after repair completion. The rule for classifying faults as safety-related remains undefined.
output.primary_goal: Track equipment faults, repair activity, safety clearance, and return-to-service decisions.
key_capabilities: Report abnormal equipment behavior and mark equipment unavailable.
Document diagnoses and work performed and mark repairs complete.
Apply different return-to-service controls for safety-related and non-safety-related faults.
unresolved_points: The rule for classifying a fault as safety-related is not defined.
